messages:
incident-bot: Alert: spike in 5xxs for /v1/embeddings and /v1/generate (us-west-2). Traffic routing errors detected. Pager duty: infra-oncall.
sofia: paging in. I'm infra-oncall for the hour. seeing ~12% 5xx on gen and 40% on embeddings for some routes.
michael: on call runtime. what's the failure mode? logs?
sofia: logs show runtime errors "IncompatibleModelVariantError: request modality=embeddings but model variant 'redwood-gpt-v9-chat' not compatible" several times. Also fallback cycles: requests fallback to us-east-1 then back to us-west-2.
tara: ml-oncall. Any recent pin/rollouts? I saw a config change 10m ago: routing policy update by @product-bot toggled 'enforce_pin_across_modalities=true' for org-673.
jack: support: two paid customers (AcroHealth, NoteBox) reported degraded embeddings returning 500s. pushed status page incident.
sofia: running quick inventory: `redwoodctl routes list --org org-673 --detail`
sofia: output snippet:
```
route id: r-142
model_pin: redwood-gpt-v9-chat
allowed_modalities: [gen, chat, embeddings]
policy: pinned_overrides=true
```
sofia: That pinned chat model does not support embeddings -> runtime throws and then fallback loops to other regions because policy allows cross-region fallback but pin is global.
michael: confirmed. There's a bug in the pin enforcement codepath: pins were applied without modality check. New policy rolled 10m ago accidentally.
devon: eng-sre. Start mitigation plan: 1) unpin route r-142 2) set route to redirect embeddings to `redwood-emb-v3` 3) disable cross-region fallback for this route until patch
sofia: I'm unpinning now: `redwoodctl pin remove --route r-142 --force`
deploy-bot: Command accepted. Pin removal queued.
sofia: change applied. re-run tests: embedding requests now return 200 for internal smoke.
jack: customer messages: AcroHealth sees embeddings restored, NoteBox still intermittent.
michael: forcing a preferred model for embeddings on the route: `redwoodctl route update r-142 --embed_model redwood-emb-v3 --no-cross-region-fallback`
michael: update applied. Observability: embeddings 5xx dropped to <1% in us-west-2, gen 5xx also improved.
sofia: I'm going to scale the edge pool for r-142 for a couple minutes to clear queued requests.
sofia: scaled.
opsbot: scaling complete.
sofia: handing off to michael for 45m while I rotate out for a customer call. Please keep the thread updated.
michael: taking handoff. summary: root cause config change set pin globally across modalities, causing incompatible variant to receive embeddings -> runtime error -> fallback loops across regions. Mitigation: removed pin, pinned a proper embed model, disabled cross-region fallback.
tara: will open an ML change request to ensure model metadata includes modalities and pins are validated.
devon: created incident ticket INC-2026-238 in Jira and added runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-pin-modalities
michael: sending short email to customers impacted with status and ETA for postmortem.
jack: support: done; pushed interim update to customers: ETA for full postmortem 48h.
sofia: last check: 15m after mitigation embeddings 5xx steady at 0.8% overall, gen 5xx 0.5%.
michael: capturing logs for the postmortem. saving core dump + stacktraces: `s3://redwood-incidents/1912349999/`
sofia: assigning follow-ups: (1) short-term - validate pins by modality in control plane (owner: eng-runtime) (2) long-term - add unit test for routing policy (owner: eng-ml) (3) customer comms (owner: support)
devon: note: small outage window ~10m where some requests were retried across regions; estimated impacted requests ~1200; two paying customers affected with transient errors.
michael: severity set to SEV-2. postmortem scheduled for tomorrow 11:00 PST. tagging for release review.
sofia: closing incident in Slack; will reopen here if any regressions. thanks team :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident resolved: status=mitigated, severity=SEV-2, duration=00:18:01
michael: leaving final note: quick hotfix PR to validation landed and will be staged to canary tomorrow.
jack: adding note to support ticket thread with link to follow-up jira.
